Title: Bum's Rush and Form of the Mist

Messages.Author: Matt Bell
Messages.Body:
Just a couple of idea I wanted to share and have clarified for a deck I'm
thinking about..

If I were to say have Gitane St. Claire gangrel extrodinare, out and
attempt to bums rush one of my preys more vulnerable vamps, the thing I see
most often is that another will attempt to block that action, now in this
case I can then procede to pound upon the unsupecting victim bringing them
to near death and right before the final blow, Form of the Mist, and
continue my action at +1 stealth can I not? and then enter into combat with
the original vamp? or perhaps get two or three more bodies thrown in my
way?

Of course S:CE would stop this and since I am the acting minion I would
have to play mine first, so if I could see it comming I would go ahead and
play it.

Now what happens when I get blocked by the minon I am attempting to attack?
Could I then play the strike combat ends to end the current combat and
immediatly enter back into combat with that minion (with an optional
manuver mind you)? And once my action has taken place (i.e. the minon
doesn't block) can the Form of the Mist no longer be played? How does it
work now?

a Few Questions I think I already know but want some clearification and
certainty on...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Matt Bell" <ma...@argosys.com> wrote:
> Just a couple of idea I wanted to share and
> have clarified for a deck I'm thinking about..
>
> If I were to say have Gitane St. Claire gangrel
> extrodinare, out and attempt to bums rush one of
> my preys more vulnerable vamps, the thing I see
> most often is that another will attempt to block
> that action, now in this case I can then procede
> to pound upon the unsupecting victim bringing
> them to near death and right before the final blow,
> Form of the Mist, and continue my action at +1
> stealth can I not? and then enter into combat with
> the original vamp?

Sure. That would work. It doesn't matter what the
blocked action was, the acting vampire can play Form
of Mist (superior) to continue that action "as if
unblocked."

> or perhaps get two or three more
> bodies thrown in my way?

Well, you could only play one superior Form of Mist
during that action, since the superior (when played
by an acting vampire) counts as an action modifier
(since it modifies the action).

> Of course S:CE would stop this and since I am the
> acting minion I would have to play mine first, so
> if I could see it comming I would go ahead and
> play it.

Right.

> Now what happens when I get blocked by the minon I
> am attempting to attack?
> Could I then play the strike combat ends to end
> the current combat and immediatly enter back into
> combat with that minion (with an optional manuver
> mind you)?

Not "immediately" - the continued action could be
blocked again (by the intended target again if he can
untap, or by someone else). But basically, yes.

> And once my action has taken place (i.e. the minon
> doesn't block) can the Form of the Mist no longer be
> played? How does it work now?

You can play it, and it will end combat. Since the
action was already in the "resolution" phase,
continuing from that point doesn't do much (no new
combat, that is).
